entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
entities.description: Substate of 5GMM-REGISTERED state indicating no suitable cell is available for the UE to camp on.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: Main registration state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: No suitable cell available
entities.description: Condition where the UE cannot find any suitable cell to camp on while in 5GMM-REGISTERED state.

relations.description: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE is a substate of the 5GMM-REGISTERED main state.
The condition of no suitable cell being available establishes the UE in the 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE substate.
The 5GMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state requires the condition that no suitable cell is available.
